feedback.description: this memory records a correction somebody gave, and who gave it

miss.description: worn beside feedback{by} on the entity that records a correction: what the corrected agent had wrong, and where the fact it lacked was. A miss is a case a way of assembling context can be scored on (@yaks/trial)

entry.description: the agent's entry that erred; everything before it in its session is what the agent had

needed.description: the entity that held the fact; absent when the graph did not hold it

across.description: what stood between the fact and the agent, when something did

told.description: restated when the person said the fact again, pointed when they said it is in the graph; absent when an agent found the miss

kind.description: which known error it was: reserve when the agent kept back budget the person said to spend, offer when it ended on "Want me to…?" instead of doing it, directive when it posted the person's remark as a directive; absent when it was none of them

memory.description: a mark on the entity holding one thing a person said about how they want something built or handled, in their own words: a session entry, a comment, a doc. The words are that entity's own text (a doc's body, an entry's content) and are never edited; memory_save makes a doc to hold them only where the graph does not hold them yet. These properties record where the words belong and what is needed to read them, and at, by and via who marked them and when. Who said them, and when, is the entity's created{at, by}

space.description: whose space they were said in — every member of that space can read them, and they are deleted with it

about.description: the app they were said about, by slug, when they were about one

context.description: the line or two needed to understand the words — what was being talked about, never a restatement of what was said

via.description: what they were marked through: a session, a client

belief.description: what a builder concluded from memories: one point a person made, or everything they said about one subject. Its doc says it; its built names the build that made it, and its cites edges what it was built from. Never edited by hand: a wrong belief is fixed in the builder that made it

scope.description: the project it holds for; absent for a principle that holds everywhere

about.description: its subject: a topic, a project, a package, a component (_comp) or a design

memory_save.title: Save a memory
memory_save.description: Save verbatim words or mark their entity with on. said+feedback marks that person's earliest matching words; otherwise creates a doc for absent words. id patches; omitted fields stay. Replacing standalone words requires memory_recall's $was.doc.body as was; marked comments/entries retain text. feedback names the correcting person. Returns applied bundles.

on.description: Entity holding the words: entry, comment or doc. If supplied, said must occur in its text.

title.description: Recall index line for a new memory; marking preserves existing text.

context.description: Discussion context in two lines; do not restate said.

scope.description: Project id/name. Omit to create a global memory or preserve existing scope.

feedback.description: Correcting person id/name; empty string means unknown. Either marks feedback.

id.description: Memory id/name to patch; omit to create.

was.description: memory_recall $was.doc.body token; required to replace existing words.

memory_recall.title: Recall memories
memory_recall.description: Read whole memories with context and $was.doc.body for memory_save.was. said ranks meaning with vectors, otherwise matches all words newest first. near ranks meaning; said then filters text. Without either, newest first. ids/scope/feedback filter.

said.description: Search words; vectors rank meaning, otherwise every word must match.

near.description: Entity id/name to rank by meaning with vectors; said then filters text.

scope.description: Only memories scoped to this project id/name, in a store that keeps projects; leave it out to recall from all.

memory_forget.title: Forget a memory
memory_forget.description: Forget one memory by id. A memory holding its own words goes to the trash whole; a mark on an entry, comment or doc is removed and the words stay where they were said. Either comes back from the trash. Returns the applied bundle.

memory_source.title: Where somebody said these words
memory_source.description: Find the earliest entity the named person wrote containing these words verbatim. Other authors' quotes do not count. Returns whole bundles; refuses when no source exists. Use its id with memory_save.on.

memory_around.title: Read the transcript around an entry
memory_around.description: Return whole transcript entries around an entry, in order, including tool calls and results. before and after count entries. Refuses a non-entry id.

memory_target.title: What an entity is aimed at

step.doing: Looking up what this is about…
step.done: Looked up what this is about

memory_target.description: Read whole entities named by its components' target fields; for a comment, what it comments on. Refuses an entity with no target.

memory_thread.title: Read the discussion an entity is in
memory_thread.description: Return the root target and all its comments and replies as whole bundles, oldest first. A target without comments answers alone.

memory_session.title: Where something happened
memory_session.description: Return the session that wrote an entity, then its worked-on or claimed tasks, as whole bundles. Refuses an entity with no session.
